tokens.name: case-000
tokens.usage: Page ground. Dark value is from the approved dark list.

tokens.name: case-100
tokens.usage: Raised surface: cards, panels, table bodies, chart plots. Default chart surface.

tokens.name: case-200
tokens.usage: Sunken surface: table header rows, zebra stripes, slider tracks, segmented-control ground.

tokens.name: case-300
tokens.usage: Hairline rules and panel borders. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: case-400
tokens.usage: Control borders: inputs, secondary buttons, segmented control. Holds 3:1 on case-000 and case-100.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text: headings, body copy, table values. On case-000, case-100, case-200.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, axis labels, legends, source lines. On case-000, case-100, case-200.

tokens.name: foam
tokens.usage: The case interior. The dark field a board is cut into, and the band behind a featured diagram. Text on it is on-foam.

tokens.name: on-foam
tokens.usage: Text and marks on foam.

tokens.name: foam-edge
tokens.usage: The lip of a cutout against foam: a 1px inner edge so an empty cutout reads as a cut hole. Holds 3:1 on foam in both themes, and an empty cutout always carries its position label as well, so the information never rests on the line alone.

tokens.name: turf
tokens.usage: The one accent: primary action, links, the highlighted series. Readable as text on case-000 and case-100 in both themes. One turf thing per view.

tokens.name: on-turf
tokens.usage: Text on a turf fill. Dark theme flips to near-black because turf lightens.

tokens.name: turf-soft
tokens.usage: Turf tint: hover ground for the primary action, selected row, info note. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring, offset 2px, on page surfaces. Clears 3:1 on case-000, case-100 and case-200. Never a data value.

tokens.name: focus-inverse
tokens.usage: The focus ring for a control sitting on foam, where focus itself is too dark to see.

tokens.name: split-cold-3
tokens.usage: Diverging cold pole: furthest below the league line for that pitcher hand.

tokens.name: split-cold-2
tokens.usage: Diverging cold, middle step.

tokens.name: split-cold-1
tokens.usage: Diverging cold, mildest step.

tokens.name: split-mid
tokens.usage: Diverging midpoint: at the league line. A neutral grey, never a hue.

tokens.name: split-warm-1
tokens.usage: Diverging warm, mildest step.

tokens.name: split-warm-2
tokens.usage: Diverging warm, middle step.

tokens.name: split-warm-3
tokens.usage: Diverging warm pole: furthest above the league line.

tokens.name: on-split-strong
tokens.usage: Text on a split-cold-3 or split-warm-3 fill. Text on the milder steps and on split-mid is plain ink.

tokens.name: grade-snug
tokens.usage: Fit grade: the piece matches the cutout's primary ask. Always paired with a filled glyph and the word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: grade-fits
tokens.usage: Fit grade: an accepted shape. Always paired with a half glyph and the word.

tokens.name: grade-loose
tokens.usage: Fit grade: any other shape. Always paired with an open glyph and the word.

tokens.name: unknown
tokens.usage: No grade and no value: Unclassified pieces, suppressed totals, missing rates. Never shown as zero.

tokens.name: viz-1
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 1. Validated order: never cycle, never skip. Fixed per entity, not per rank.

tokens.name: viz-2
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 2.

tokens.name: viz-3
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 3. Slots 1 to 3 pass all-pairs: the cap for scatter and small multiples.

tokens.name: viz-4
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 4.

tokens.name: viz-5
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 5. A sixth series folds into Other in case-400.

tokens.name: viz-grid
tokens.usage: Gridlines and ticks. Recessive: 1px, horizontal only.

tokens.name: viz-baseline
tokens.usage: Zero line, the league line, and the lid of a capacity bin. Holds 3:1 on case-100 in both themes, because the lid and the league line carry meaning.

tokens.name: hero-from
tokens.usage: Start of the page-title text gradient, left to right. Text only; the one gradient this system allows.

tokens.name: hero-to
tokens.usage: End of the page-title text gradient. Both ends hold 4.5:1 on case-000.

tokens.name: foam-deep
tokens.usage: Cutout interiors and the case shell recess: one step deeper than foam. Dark value is from the approved dark list.

tokens.name: grade-snug-on-foam
tokens.usage: Snug grade drawn on foam, where the page grade colours are too dark to see. Always with the filled glyph.

tokens.name: grade-fits-on-foam
tokens.usage: Fits grade drawn on foam. Always with the half glyph.

tokens.name: grade-loose-on-foam
tokens.usage: Loose grade drawn on foam. Always with the open glyph.

tokens.name: unknown-on-foam
tokens.usage: No grade or no value, drawn on foam.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page title (text-5xl). One per page; text-4xl at phone width. Carries the hero text gradient.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card and diagram titles, player names (text-xl).

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Every number traces to a source, an assumption, or a versioned calculation.
styles.usage: Standfirst under a page title (text-lg). ink-muted.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Visible foam is friction; an empty cutout is a position nobody covers.
styles.usage: Body copy (text-base). Measure about 65ch. Main buttons, semibold.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Split run estimates are a judgment layer and never change an engine number.
styles.usage: Card body, findings, source lines (text-sm). Header buttons, semibold.

styles.name: stat-xl
styles.usage: The one number a view answers with (text-4xl). Tabular figures.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, tags, column headers, axis ticks, sources (text-xs). Sentence case, not all caps.

tokens.name: spacing-25
tokens.usage: Hairline offsets only.

tokens.name: spacing-50
tokens.usage: Glyph to text, tag padding block, gap between packed pieces.

tokens.name: spacing-75
tokens.usage: Inline gaps, legend item gap, button padding block.

tokens.name: spacing-100
tokens.usage: Table cell and control padding, button padding inline.

tokens.name: spacing-200
tokens.usage: Panel padding at phone width; page side gutter; stack gap.

tokens.name: spacing-300
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gap between a diagram and its readout.

tokens.name: spacing-400
tokens.usage: Gap between modules. The cutout pitch on a case.

tokens.name: spacing-500
tokens.usage: Hairline offsets only.

tokens.name: spacing-600
tokens.usage: Section spacing.

tokens.name: spacing-700
tokens.usage: Large section spacing.

tokens.name: spacing-800
tokens.usage: Page top on the overview.

tokens.name: spacing-900
tokens.usage: Overview section rhythm.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, inputs, table highlight cells, cutouts. The house corner is nearly square.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels, buttons, chart frames, tooltips, bar data ends. Nested shapes under a 32px gap: inner = outer minus gap, only when above 2px, so contents of a 4px panel stay square.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Slider thumbs, toggle tracks, the floating nav.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Tooltips, popovers and the floating nav only, tinted toward the ground. Panels sit on hairlines.
